event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
4:37 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 81 degrees, relative humidity 49 percent, barometer 30.05 inches, adjusted altitude 2,877 feet.

Hagan is 34 - 27 against Beckman in prior events and Hagan is 5 - 3 against Beckman in prior final rounds. 

A coin flip off of the line, Beckman gets out in front early and extends his ead all the way through the run.

Jack Beckman's incremental margins: 60ft(0.010), 330 ft(0.032), 660ft(0.053).  MOV: 0.0667 seconds (approximately 31 feet).

Beckman wins his 39th career win. he doubled-up, winning the callout and the main race, for the second time. He won both the first time in 2015.
